newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Exploration A, B preferred converted.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Exploration A, B preferred converted.

text.p: United States Exploration Inc said Wednesday 250,000 shares of Series A and 104,000 shares of Series B preferred stock were converted into unregistered common stock of the company at $2.25 per share.

The action resulted in issuance of 786,667 shares of common stock. In keeping with terms of the conversion agreement, a majority of the newly issued common was then acquired by certain United States Exploration shareholders.
The balance of 150,000 shares was retained by the previous holder of the Series A and B preferred.
United States Exploration also said it agreed to issue common stock in satisfaction of the dividend on the preferred, based on a conversion price related to the price of the common stock in November.

The preferred originally was issued to Tipperary Corp for the acquisition of the company's Ingleside, Texas, oil refinery. It was accomplished through issuance of preferred stock valued at $5 per share.
